title: Vanilla PvP Lite
description: This project adds a Vanilla+ PvP resource pack with small totems, reduced fire, smaller shields, and less particles for better PvP visibility.
body:
This project adds Vanilla+ PvP Lite, a lightweight PvP resource pack designed to improve visibility while keeping a vanilla feel.

It includes small totems, reduced fire overlay, smaller shields, and reduced particles to make PvP clearer and smoother without changing the core Minecraft style.
